verification.cumulative_regression_cause: Non-action possessive-focus FRAME identifiers were passed as action GOAL hints after multi-hint integration
verification.cumulative_regression_repair: Only action-inheriting binding kinds may contribute action goal hints

mechanisms: Exactly-two and all-action selectors resolve active action sets into one group binding plus one typed member binding per action.
Multi-goal action analysis emits separate language reports and grounded claims without promoting reported completion to verified execution.
Plural proposition reference resolves only when exactly two active propositions have two distinct attributed sources; larger or non-unique sets fail closed.
Explicit corrections supersede the latest active proposition from the same normalized source even when state vocabulary does not expose a comparable lexical axis.
Discourse-repair prefixes such as Correction: are removed at actor extraction and never become part of actor identity.
Possessive focus bridging remains non-authoritative, and its frame identity is excluded from action-goal hint routing.
Grounded group realization cites each selected action and accepted receipt while preserving planned, reported, and verified states.
residual_limits: This remains a bounded deterministic Language Cortex and does not establish GPT-level general language competence.
Plural proposition grouping currently requires exactly two active distinct sources rather than arbitrary discourse groups and memberships.
Action group markers and state-query paraphrases use a compact inspectable vocabulary rather than unrestricted paraphrase understanding.
Possessive bridging is bounded to explicit current discourse focus and does not solve unrestricted associative bridging.
Long conversations with nested group membership, interruptions, and open-vocabulary repairs require broader frozen suites.
Natural realization is structurally faithful but still less flexible and natural than a generative language model.
next_program_order: open-vocabulary pragmatic paraphrase transfer across the six-axis integrated path
longer group membership and speaker-set tracking across interruptions and topic returns
broader associative bridging with typed ambiguity and provenance
more natural evidence-grounded realization without granting the language layer semantic authority
